title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in bPlugins PDF…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in bPlugins PDF Poster versions up to 2.6.1. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling an attacker to inject malicious scripts. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity level.
